scope: P0 FCLK CCF/SLCR recovery plus semantic 50 MHz classification closure
physical_execution: A physical APPLY completed the hardware transition before this semantic-validator change; no hardware was executed for this change.

root_cause.apply_eio: The earlier SLCR lock ordering issue was fixed: physical CCF set-rate now changed FPGA0_CLK_CTRL and direct FCLK0 to 50 MHz. The remaining -EIO was only the old direct verifier requiring 0x00400500 instead of accepting the legal physical 0x00101400 encoding.
root_cause.restore_erange: clk_round_rate(fclk0, 100000000) is 99999999 under the golden DT ps_clk model, so the previous exact-equality restore precheck rejected an already verified direct 100 MHz hardware state.

physical_50mhz_0x142.0x002: P0_FCLK_GUARD_VALIDATE_FCLK_CTRL: the previous validator required the single reference encoding 0x00400500, so it rejected the physical legal 0x00101400 encoding (SRCSEL=0, DIV0=20, DIV1=1).
physical_50mhz_0x142.0x040: P0_FCLK_GUARD_VALIDATE_CCF_ROUND_RATE: the previous status collector set this bit unconditionally even when CCF reported an exact 50000000 Hz round result.
physical_50mhz_0x142.0x100: P0_FCLK_GUARD_VALIDATE_CCF_ENABLED: external modules cannot inspect CCF internal enable-reference state; its unavailable observation was incorrectly treated as a 50 MHz state failure.

fix.apply: Keep FCLK0 reset asserted; unlock SLCR only around CCF clk_set_rate/clk_prepare_enable, immediately relock, then verify direct 50 MHz and tolerated CCF observation. No apply failure path releases reset.
fix.recovery: From verified GOLDEN_100_RESET_ASSERTED, skip clk_set_rate entirely, verify golden IO PLL/FCLK/reset/level-shifter state, balance an owned CCF enable if present, then release reset. From 50 MHz, permit only the DT-model ±1 Hz 100 MHz round result and verify direct golden hardware before reset release.
fix.diagnostics: ABI 6 transition diagnostics report last APPLY stage, errno, request, CCF rate, FPGA0_CLK_CTRL, direct FCLK, and FPGA reset before/after.
fix.semantic_50mhz_validation: Accept only documented FPGA0_CLK_CTRL source/divider fields, SRCSEL=IO PLL, nonzero one-based DIV0/DIV1, exact direct 50000000 Hz, asserted reset when required, and the existing CCF observation contract. Reserved/unrelated bits cause fail-closed rejection. CCF round-rate is now required only when the exact-round status flag is absent; unavailable CCF enable-reference observation remains visible but is not a state prerequisite. APPLY programming is unchanged.

tests.semantic_50mhz_logic: host C test passed: physical 0x00101400 decodes SRCSEL=0, DIV0=20, DIV1=1, direct 50000000 Hz, validates with zero 50 MHz clock errors, and classifies as 50MHZ_RESET_ASSERTED. The legal reference 0x00400500 (DIV0=5, DIV1=4) is also accepted; reserved-bit and zero-divider negatives are rejected.
tests.phase06f_rtl_simulation: Icarus Verilog passed: 45068 power results checked; TLAST and backpressure testbench coverage retained
